BESSEL FUNCTIONS OF FRACTIONAL ORDER (p.444)
Modified Spherical Bessel Functions of the Third Kind
10.2.15  \sqrt{\tfrac12\pi/z}K_{n+\tfrac12}(z)=\tfrac12\pi ie^{(n+1)\pi i/2}h_n^{(1)}(ze^{\tfrac12\pi i}) \quad (-\pi<\arg z\leq\tfrac12\pi)
=-\tfrac12\pi ie^{-(n+1)\pi i/2}h_n^{(2)}(ze^{-\tfrac12\pi i}) \quad (\tfrac12\pi<\arg z\leq\pi)
=(\tfrac12\pi/z)e^{-z}\sum_0^n (n+\tfrac12, k)(2z)^{-k}
10.2.16  K_{n+\tfrac12}(z)=K_{-n-\tfrac12}(z) \quad (n=0, 1, 2, \dots)
The Functions \sqrt{\tfrac12\pi/z}K_{n+\tfrac12}(z), n=0, 1, 2
10.2.17  \sqrt{\tfrac12\pi/z}K_{1/2}(z)=(\tfrac12\pi/z)e^{-z}
\sqrt{\tfrac12\pi/z}K_{3/2}(z)=(\tfrac12\pi/z)e^{-z}(1+z^{-1})
\sqrt{\tfrac12\pi/z}K_{5/2}(z)=(\tfrac12\pi/z)e^{-z}(1+3z^{-1}+3z^{-2})
Elementary Properties
Recurrence Relations
f_n(z): \sqrt{\tfrac12\pi/z}I_{n+\tfrac12}(z), (-1)^{n+1}\sqrt{\tfrac12\pi/z}K_{n+\tfrac12}(z) \quad (n=0, \pm1, \pm2, \dots)
10.2.18  f_{n-1}(z)-f_{n+1}(z)=(2n+1)z^{-1}f_n(z)
10.2.19  nf_{n-1}(z)+(n+1)f_{n+1}(z)=(2n+1) \frac{d}{dz} f_n(z)
10.2.20  \frac{n+1}{z} f_n(z)+\frac{d}{dz} f_n(z)=f_{n-1}(z)
(See 10.2.22.)
10.2.21  -\frac{n}{z} f_n(z)+\frac{d}{dz}f_n(z)=f_{n+1}(z)
(See 10.2.23.)
Differentiation Formulas
f_n(z): \sqrt{\tfrac12\pi/z}I_{n+\tfrac12}(z), (-1)^{n+1}\sqrt{\tfrac12\pi/z}K_{n+\tfrac12}(z) \quad (n=0, \pm1, \pm2, \dots)
10.2.22  \left(\frac{1}{z}\frac{d}{dz}\right)^m [z^{n+1}f_n(z)]=z^{n-m+1}f_{n-m}(z)
10.2.23  \left(\frac{1}{z}\frac{d}{dz}\right)^m [z^{-n}f_n(z)]=z^{-n-m}f_{n+m}(z) \quad (m=1, 2, 3, \dots)
